lines.zh: 我拄着骨杖，一步一步挪。
lines.en: I lean on my bone staff and shuffle along.
My robe drags in the mud.
The skull on my staff knocks and rattles.

lines.zh: 这颗头是上一个法师的。
lines.en: This skull belonged to the last shaman.

lines.zh: 村口的火我每天都要看一遍。
lines.en: I check the village fires every day.
I circle the camp, muttering.

lines.zh: 鼻子比眼睛先知道有人来。
lines.en: My nose knows a stranger before my eyes do.

lines.zh: 脚下的土有脚印，我记下了。
lines.en: There are prints in the soil; I have noted them.

lines.zh: 我走到哪，草就往哪边倒。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass leans away.
Dried mushrooms hang at my waist.
I walk and scatter powder as I go.
This path leads to the sacrifice pit.
The pouch at my waist is nearly empty.

lines.zh: 骨头敲在石头上，一声一声。
lines.en: Bone taps stone, one beat after another.
I stop and test the wind.

lines.zh: 这一带我闭着眼也能走。
lines.en: I could walk this stretch blindfolded.
I squat with the staff across my knees.
Smoke rises from the fire.
I am tossing things into the fire.
The smell is not right.
I throw in a handful of soil.
The flame changes colour.

lines.zh: 村里的人都不敢靠近我。
lines.en: The village keeps its distance from me.
They should.
I mutter words no one understands.
The mushrooms click softly at my waist.
I lift one finger and cast.
And the wind turns.

lines.zh: 我数着锅里还剩几根骨头。
lines.en: I count the bones left in the pot.

lines.zh: 有个年轻人从远处看我。
lines.en: A youngster watches me from a distance.
I turn my face away.
Every knuckle of mine clicks.
You do not smell of goblins.
Then this is interesting.
I tilt my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 杖是拄着的，不是举着的。
lines.en: The staff is for leaning, not raising.
Though it can be raised.
Your hands are behind your back.
I cannot see, and I can guess.
You carry the smell of herbs.
Or to be cursed?
You stand a head taller than me.
That means very little.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西还没放下。
lines.en: You still have not put that down.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，杖差点脱手。
lines.en: I stumble and nearly lose the staff.
The hem of my robe is torn.
I can brew my way past this.
Blood drips on the powder and it changes colour.
I get up on the staff.
Blood drips on the bone charm; the spell breaks.
The bone aches more than the skin.
Do not think old means harmless.
My breathing is loud.
I will find you later.
Mushrooms? Set them down first.

lines.zh: 我的毒云，不是给你吃的。
lines.en: My poison cloud isn't for eating.
Flour, bone meal, and this.
The mix must be complete.
Do not shake; the powder will spill.
This is not enough to buy a life.
A little more.
I tip them into my pouch.
You are not cursed. For now.
Go on; I am staying.
This offering won't buy a blessing.

lines.zh: 我想要的是那种会发光的。
lines.en: I want the kind that glows.
You will have to make another trip.
This green jade suits my taste.
Where did you dig this up?
I need three and you have one.

lines.zh: 你撞在一个老哥布林身上。
lines.en: You bumped into an old goblin.

lines.zh: 我差点撒了手里的东西。
lines.en: I nearly spilled what I held.
Two steps back.
Don't touch my bone charms.
Powder on the ground is wasted.
Don't shove me; the spell will break.
That patch took me three days.
Shift to the side.

lines.zh: 我点一把火，再放一片毒云。
lines.en: I light a fire, then drop a poison cloud.
Your boots are heavy.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，早不干这个。
lines.en: At my age, that is long done.
My time goes into the fire.
You asked the wrong goblin.
There are younger ones in the village.
My name burned in that fire.
Ask the fire, not me.
The fire is dying; I must watch it.
Do not stand by the pit.
I keep out of village matters.
My fire is more interesting than that.
This coin on the ground.
Gold. I will keep it.

lines.zh: 村里没人会给你这个价。
lines.en: No one in the village will give you this price.

lines.zh: 我把金币塞进袍子内袋。
lines.en: I tuck the coin into my robe's inner pocket.
This is my brewing money.
There is another piece over there.
You did not see it?
Your eyes are poor.
I picked it up for you.
This one is a bit old.
You stepped on the pit's edge.
That is my circle.
I raise the staff and point it at you.
Do not go near that fire behind you.
It knows an unwelcome smell.
The head of my staff points at you.
That counts as the beginning.
You should not have entered this circle.
I traced a line beneath your feet.
One step deeper and it is too late.
I circle you, muttering.
Powder falls at your feet.
Step back and the circle widens.
Wherever you step, you are inside.
This hand of mine is raised.
The powder in the soil is moving.
That is not the wind.

lines.zh: 你的影子在圈里越来越淡。
lines.en: Your shadow fades inside the circle.
My staff scrapes through the mud.
Each stroke draws the circle tighter.
I lift the staff and slam it down.
Flames leap up at your feet.
One step back and the circle still holds.
Poison smoke crawls along the ground.
My chanting quickens.
You are starting to lose sight.
Even I fear this one.
I fling powder at your face.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛会先瞎一会儿。
lines.en: Your eyes will go blind a while.
In that time, I finished the chant.

lines.zh: 火堆边上多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shadow appears by the fire.
I drag my staff into the village.
The smell of bone arrives first.
Today calls for a rite.
Someone add wood to the fire.
Let me look at this ground.
Too small; not enough for a circle.
Then I will use them.
I climb up from the pit's side.
Ash is still on my hands.

lines.zh: 火苗爬上骨杖，我赶紧甩开。
lines.en: Flame climbs my bone staff; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，杖也飞了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and the staff flies off.

lines.zh: 骨杖沉了，我呛了好几口。
lines.en: My bone staff sinks; I swallow water.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的粉末全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters every grain of my powder.
My poison cloud is still drifting.
That spell is stronger than mine.
Three days hungry and the chant comes out wrong.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的杖头，骨头裂了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my staff and the bone splits.
The void swallows my chant.
